name: LinuxCNC router
description: Millimetre RS274 dialect for a LinuxCNC gantry router. Absolute moves, cutter compensation cancelled, IJK arcs and helices, path blend G64 P0.01. No rotary axis: a gantry is XYZ, and a program with an A or B angle is rejected. A Probe event with a contact pose and a feed is G38.2 toward that pose (LinuxCNC straight probe; G38.2 alarms if the probe does not trip; https://linuxcnc.org/docs/stable/html/gcode/g-code.html#gcode:g38). A Probe with no contact pose or no feed is refused. Named Other processes vacuum and dust are immediate digital outputs M64 Pn and M65 Pn (https://linuxcnc.org/docs/stable/html/gcode/m-code.html#mcode:m62-m65). digital_out.vacuum_pin defaults to 0 and digital_out.dust_pin defaults to 1. Any other Other name is refused. Not proven on a machine.
